settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
1. Cleanse: Start with clean, dry skin. For best results, use an oil-free cleanser like our Mangosteen Cleanser.
  2. Apply Conductive Gel: Apply Restore Conductive Gel generously across all treatment areas.
  3. Power On & Adjust: Turn on the MyoLift™ Mini and select your preferred intensity setting.
  4. Glide & Lift: Gently glide the applicator probes over the forehead, cheeks, jawline, and neck following your instructional guide.
  5. Pinch and Hold: For added lift, hold the probes in areas like the brow and jawline to target deeper facial muscles.
  6. Finish: Rinse off excess gel and apply your preferred serum, such as our Anti-Aging Serum or Revital-C Serum.
  7. Recommended Use: Use daily for the first two weeks (30-minute sessions), then continue with 1–2 sessions per week for maintenance and continued skin rejuvenation.

settings.title: Product Features
settings.content:
• True Microcurrent Technology: Delivers low-level electrical current (up to 400 microAmps) to tone and re-educate facial muscles.
  • Dual Wavelength Frequencies: Customizes treatment to target specific facial muscles for improved lift, tone, and definition.
  • Compact & Travel-Friendly: Lightweight, rechargeable design perfect for use at home or on the go.
  • Conductive Accessory Compatibility: Works with gels, masks, and probe accessories to tailor treatments to your skin’s needs.
  • Digital Display with Timer: Simple interface with screen to monitor intensity and treatment time.

settings.title: Benefits
settings.content:
• Lift & Firm Sagging Skin: Helps define cheekbones, jawline, brows, and neck for a more sculpted appearance.
  • Reduce Fine Lines & Wrinkles: Smooths expression lines and supports skin elasticity.
  • Boost Collagen & Circulation: Enhances ATP production to support firmer, more radiant skin.
  • Improve Product Absorption: Increases penetration of serums and moisturizers for deeper skincare benefits.
  • Safe & Non-Invasive: A gentle, effective alternative to more aggressive facial treatments.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: How do I turn on the Myolift Mini device?
settings.text1:
After charging the device, remove the charger from the unit. Press the circular
on/off button located on the top side of the device. The device will turn on and you will see
the display on the screen. Please note that the device has a safety mechanism built-in
and it will not turn on if the device is plugged into the charger.
settings.title2: Is the MyoLift Mini safe for all skin types?
settings.text2:
Yes, the MyoLift Mini is safe for all skin types, including sensitive skin.
Microcurrent technology is non-invasive, gentle, and works at a cellular level to improve skin
health without causing irritation or damage.
settings.title3: How often should I use the MyoLift Mini to see results?
settings.text3:
For optimal results, it is recommended to use the MyoLift Mini 2-3 times per week.
Many users start seeing noticeable improvements in skin tone and tightness after 4-6 weeks
of consistent use, with continued improvements over time.
settings.title4: How long does each MyoLift Mini treatment session take?
settings.text4:
A typical MyoLift Mini treatment session lasts about 15-30 minutes, depending on
the area of focus. You can customize your routine by targeting specific areas like the
forehead, cheeks, jawline, or entire face for a full treatment.
settings.title5: Do I need any special training to use the MyoLift Mini at home?
settings.text5:
Although no special training is required, there is a learning curve since the
Myolift Mini comes with two probes. However, our training videos will guide you through,
step by step, how to use the MyoLift Mini at home. The device is designed to be
user-friendly and comes with easy-to-follow instructions. There are also resources available
and free webinars to help you get the most out of your treatments.
